title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E02 — Better Than Takeout: Indian-Spiced Lentils
Jamie makes frugal leftovers fun with spaghetti frittata, bakes air-fryer pork pies using affordable mince, and preps a batch of butternut squash dal. Plus, budget-friendly chicken shish kebabs and thrifty mint choc chip whoopie pies!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E03 — Easy Stuffed Dumplings and British Fish & Chips
Jamie saves money with easy stuffed leftover dumplings, a budget frozen-fish chip shop cheat, a store-cupboard jar blondie cake, pocket-pleasing pork tacos, and a brilliant air-fryer tinned pineapple tarte tatin dessert!

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E01 — Not Your Nonna's Risotto
Jamie makes a low-cost dosa, crispy chicken, oozy barley risotto, beef stew and shortbread biscuits.

title: Jamie Oliver's Money-Saving Meals
description:
S01 E06 — Easy Chicken Curry and Feta Tomato Pasta
Jamie makes an air-fryer tomato and roast feta pasta using leftover noodles, a budget rolled carrot cake, and a cheap family chicken curry. Plus, an epic cheese-on-toast Welsh rarebit upgrade and frozen fish Chinese-inspired dough parcels!

title: Thanksgiving HOT TAKE: Is Turkey actually the worst?
description:
S01 E01 — Forking Delicious: Top 10 Thanksgiving Dishes
On this episode, we're talking turkey. That's right, it's time for Thanksgiving! Join our panel of thankful experts as they gather to offer their insights and opinions as we count down your top ten turkey day must-haves.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S07 E03 — Thanksgiving Dinner
Thanksgiving dinner will be a breeze this year thanks to Frankie's struggle tips for a delicious holiday meal. From a simple turkey entrée to a new twist on a classic dessert, Frankie makes a feast without unstuffing his wallet.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E10 — Thanksgiving Leftovers
SeriesTMSID: SH030064860000. Series Description: The struggle is real, but it doesn't mean your food has to suffer. Chef Frankie Celenza shows you how to make delicious meals that won't break the bank.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E09 — Grubby Good Food
Send your taste buds on a first class food tour without even leaving the Struggle kitchen! Frankie whips up his favorite regional specialties from five destinations, making them as authentic as possible while sticking to his budget.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E08 — Meals Under $7
At a loss when your pantry is empty? With these recipes, you can walk into any grocery store with only $7 and walk out with everything you need for an entire meal. Because yes, you can whip up a nutritious meal at an affordable price!

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E07 — Frankie's Italian Faves
Frankie goes back to his roots with these Italian recipes that even his Nonno would love.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S07 E05 — Spice Spice Baby
Frankie kicks it up a notch in the Struggle Kitchen with flavor-packed, spicy recipes, and some hot tips for adding layers of flavor. But don't sweat it, these warming dishes won't burn your cash or your taste buds.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E06 — But First, Brunch
Bring your loved ones together over a delicious brunch spread made with love. Whether you're celebrating a major milestone or simply toasting to the weekend, Frankie's money-saving menu will have guests buzzing for more.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S07 E02 — French Bistro
Bonsoir, indeed! Join Frankie as he cooks up elegant but achievable French classics that will transport you to an evening on the Seine, complete with some savvy wine tips without the hefty cost of a plane ticket.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E05 — Struggle Splurge
The key to treating yourself on a budget is to keep it simple: these elegant dinners taste like restaurant specials, but they can be prepared in under one hour - perfect for easy weeknight meals for a family of any size on a busy schedule.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E03 — Eat Your Greens
Going green isn't just a trend; it's a no-brainer! When the veggies are in season and the prices are at their lowest, Frankie's colorful recipes and zero waste tips will have you celebrating the savings with fresh spring produce.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E02 — We Knead Pizza
Cancel the pizza delivery, it's time to save money and build your pies from scratch. With three different pizza styles, you're bound to find one that satisfies your craving without digging into your wallet.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E02 — Homemade-ish
Last minute company leaving you in a pinch? Frankie has you covered with these easy recipes featuring store bought staples. With a few Struggle tips, these basic ingredients can be transformed into dishes that will impress your guests.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S07 E01 — Pizza My Heart
On this special delivery episode of Struggle Meals, Frankie explores three ways to make delicious pizzas, and shares clever tips to make an A+ pie without dropping your dough on expensive ingredients.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S09 E06 — Whole Chicken 101
Join Frankie to learn the ins and outs of using every part of a chicken, as he demonstrates how to maximize the value and minimize waste. By cooking smarter, you'll have three delectable recipes to last you the whole week.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E09 — Picnic Lunches
It's field trip day, and Frankie shows off his best handheld lunches perfect for leisurely days at the park, the beach or the pool. These sturdy meals are made to travel and only get better with time.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S08 E07 — Saved By The Bowl
When you're craving a quick nutritious meal, say no more to throwing cash down the gutter for overpriced takeout bowls! Frankie recreates three restaurant favorites for a fraction of the cost, sparing your bank account without sacrificing flavor.

title: Struggle Meals
description:
S07 E04 — Meatless Mains
Start a new tradition at the dinner table this year with a meat free spin on your favorite main courses. Learn new tips and tricks to make your veggie forward dinner so delightful that even the biggest meat eaters will be back for seconds.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E01 — The Wonderful World of Pizza
Frankie makes pizza magic with two incredible doughs, turning his kitchen into a pizza party with grilled sausage pizza, cheesy Grandma Pies, golden Panzerotti, and a sweet dessert pizza topped with ricotta, berries, and honey.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E03 — Lunch That Goes the Distance
Frankie fuels up for action making hot Oatmeal, and Energy Date Balls, before he cooks up the perfect post-ride feast of cheesy Juicy Lucy Burgers, Ramp-loaded pasta salad, and a maple ginger switchel to cool it all down.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E04 — Pasta From Scratch
Frankie explores his Italian roots, pairing each pasta shape with its perfect sauce-from Cavatelli with Super Green Sauce to Pappardelle in pork ragout, ricotta Gnocchi with punchy anchovy pecorino, and cozy Squash Orzotto with bloomed poppy seeds.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E02 — Italian Smokehouse
Frankie fires up a steakhouse-style spread with Italian flair from golden beets and buttery mushrooms to a sizzling Bistecca alla Fiorentina steak with salmoriglio sauce, and a smooth cold brew affogato granita.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E08 — Frankie's Feast of the Seven Fishes
Frankie reimagines the Feast of the Seven Fishes with a shellfish-free spread making Smoked Whitefish Salad, Anchovy Butter Toast, Salt-baked Red Snapper, Trout Scapece, and Pasta con le Sarde, with a helping hand from his mom.

title: Let Frankie Cook
description:
S01 E07 — Thanksgiving Spatchcock & Sides
Frankie skips the stress and roasts a juicy spatchcocked turkey, then goes big on sides-cardamom rolls, Sweet & Savory Dauphinoise Potatoes, Brussels Sprouts with Bacon Jam, and a bright Citrus Salad with smoked salt.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E01 — Crispy Pork Noodles and Cheesy Chard Cannelloni
Jamie celebrates rhubarb in a lip-smacking sauce, heroes spinach in a silky goat's cheese risotto and marries vibrant basil with chard in a crowd-pleasing cheesy spring cannelloni.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E02 — Spring Onion Chicken Curry and Sausage Broccoli Pizza
Jamie elevates asparagus spears for a fishy feat, makes spring onions the star of the show in his spicy green chicken curry and gives purple sprouting broccoli an Italian-inspired makeover.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E03 — Stuffed Salmon Celebration and Almond Custard Tart
Jamie snazzes up some spuds with wild garlic pesto, creates a broad bean mezze, rustles up a beautiful spring salad and honours rhubarb in a luscious custard tart with almond brittle.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E07 — Jamie's ULTIMATE Autumn Garden FEAST!
Jamie kicks off autumn with Italian-inspired cheesy cabbage pasta and smoky sweetcorn burgers with feta. He shares tips for storing onions and saving tomato seeds, finishing with a beautiful tomato galette for a perfect fall meal.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E10 — Jamie Makes the World's Best Christmas Lasagne
Jamie throws the most festive Christmas Party! The menu includes cheesy filo parcels, a make-ahead Christmas cauliflower lasagne, and jerk-rubbed hasselback root veg with chicken kebabs. He finishes with a fudgy sticky toffee coffee pudding.

title: Jamie Oliver: Seasons
description:
S01 E11 — Jamie's Show-Stopping Christmas Porchetta
Jamie welcomes his family to his outdoor shed for Christmas dinner! He swaps turkey for a show-stopping festive porchetta, served with crispy roast potatoes. The menu also includes a veggie Brussels sprouts pie and a mulled wine pear pavlova.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S07 E02 — Cajun-Style Grilled Wild Turkey & Creamy Tetrazzini
Andrew gives holiday turkey the Wild Game Kitchen treatment with grilled turkey tetrazzini and a butter basted Cajun-spiced whole bird roasted over crawfish, andouille and cornbread stuffing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S07 E05 — Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird
Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab
Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog
For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E07 — Grilled Clams Casino and Garlicky Clam Pizza
Andrew Zimmern celebrates cherrystone clams with two show-stopping recipes. He prepares classic grilled clams casino with pancetta, then pushes boundaries with an innovative grilled pizza topped with clams, garlic, chiles, and cheese.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E01 — The Best Fish You're Not Eating
Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E08 — Elk Tenderloin Tostadas and Grilled Rack of Ribs
Andrew Zimmern highlights lean elk, first crafting classic Mexican tostadas with grilled tenderloin, avocado, and homemade salsa macha. Then, he grills a whole rack of elk, serving it with creamy colcannon, tarragon emulsion, and rosemary charcoal.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E01 — Grilled Squid Salad and Crispy Squid on the Plancha
Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E05 — The King of Open-Fire Paella
Andrew Zimmern showcases quail two ways: classic Southern fried quail with lemon-basil aioli, and as an elevated topping for a traditional open-fire paella, complete with crispy socarrat. He proves this small bird makes an extraordinary dinner.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E01 — Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Grilled Turkey Legs, Creamed Greens and Lemon Orzo.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E09 — Wild Seafood Risotto
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies working with live sea urchin and scallops by creating a showstopping seafood risotto.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E08 — Italian Alps Comfort Food
Jamie is high up in the Italian Alps cooking some great comfort food, including dumplings, mind-blowing macaroni cheese, and a classic red wine and sausage risotto.

Jamie visits Basilicata in search of some old school Italian recipes and meets a family of shepherds and an 89-year-old macaroni master.

description:
S01 E06 — Tuscan Farmhouse Classics
Jamie is taking spaghetti bolognese to the next level and re-creating a mind-blowing Jewish-Italian recipe. There's also beef stew with pappardelle.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy
description:
S01 E03 — Making Pizza in Naples
Jamie visits the pizza capital of Italy to learn recipes from the locals and tries acquapazza, fish poached in crazy water.

title: Jamie Oliver Cooks Italy

Jamie heads for one of the hottest food destinations in Italy, making hand-crafted pasta, a special seafood stew, and the region's answer to paella.

Jamie celebrates summer with roasted fennel pork & gratin, oozy pea risotto, and rainbow slaw chicken wraps. He shares edible hanging basket tips. The feast finishes with stunning mackerel on sun-dried tomato couscous with colorful beets.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E01 — Alpine Lamb Ribs from Siddoway Sheep Company
Jess joins the lamb-raising Siddoway family as they begin sorting the animals that are ready for processing. She then returns to the lodge, where she demonstrates how to prepare and grill lamb ribs.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E02 — Benton's Famous Tennessee Hams
Jess loves country hams and there's no better place to visit than Benton's--a family-run business that's been perfecting curing and aging techniques for over 50 years.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E04 — Cylon Rolling Acres Goat Birria Tacos
Jess pitches in at Cylon Rolling Acres as owner Leslie Svacina runs her direct-to-consumer goat meat business.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E06 — Nashville Hot Dove Sliders at Redstone Ranch
Jess and her husband Chris head to their favorite hunting grounds, Redstone Ranch, situated in the heart of the migratory dove flyway.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E07 — Oklahoma's Wild Hog Sausage Roll
Jess heads to Oklahoma, where she takes aim at one of the state's estimated 1.5 million feral hogs. Then, she makes a wild hog sausage roll with jalapeño and cheddar.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E05 — Fort Worth Barbacoa Feast
Jess and her good friends, Fort Worth pitmaster Joe Riscky and Chef Juan Rodriguez, prepare a traditional barbacoa feast.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E09 — South Texas Deer Capture
Jess visits the East Foundation in South Texas to participate in a fast-paced, yet careful and methodical deer capture.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E02 — Smoked Elk Sandwiches at Juniper Mountain Ranch
Jess and her friend Shaundi Campbell meet up with guides from Juniper Mountain Ranch in southeastern Idaho to cull an elk for her smoked elk sandwiches.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S02 E01 — Whole Hog BBQ with Pitmaster Pat Martin
Jess teams up with legendary West Tennessee pitmaster and whole hog expert Pat Martin to cook a hog overnight and enjoy a special cut of beef from Australia.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E08 — Live Fire Venison Backstrap in Oklahoma
With the help of a local Oklahoma guide, Jess sets out to hunt an axis deer, then shares butchery techniques and prepares a delicious backstrap grilled over live fire.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E03 — Northstar Bison Smash Burger
Jess visits Northstar Bison to learn about the small family-run ranch's breeding and processing operation, then prepares her signature smash burger.

title: Hardcore Carnivore
description:
S01 E10 — Texas Tomahawk from Wyatt Ranches
Jess heads to Wyatt Ranches in South Texas to check out the cattle ranching operation they've been running since 1965.

S03 E02 — Carne Adovada
Chef Andrew Zimmern prepares Carne Adovada.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E10 — Holy Mackerel!
Andrew Zimmern champions the often-overlooked mackerel with a main salad of pickled filets, charred tomatoes, grilled frisée, and sweet summer peaches. Then, he grills it whole seasoned with caramelized onions, rutabaga mash and charred grapes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E03 — A Whole Roasted Hog
For pig roast perfection, Chef Andrew Zimmern marinates a whole hog.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E05 — Creamy Clam Chowder and Mussels in Spicy Tomato Sauce
Chef Andrew Zimmern demystifies cooking clams, mussels and oysters.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E06 — Braised Pigeon with Homemade Herb Gnocchi
Chef Andrew Zimmern cooks braised squab with olives and vinegar, a perfect meal for a fall evening.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E07 — Goat Curry with Rice Pilaf and Carmelized Onions
Chef Andrew butchers a whole goat, using the leg and backstrap for a braised curry.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E08 — Nashville Hot Pheasant and Mint Basil Lemonade
Chef Andrew Zimmern takes a spin on Nashville-style hot fried chicken. Hot and spicy, batter coated, crispy fried pheasant is paired with a spinach salad topped with bacon vinaigrette and ice-cold mint basil lemonade.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S07 E05 — Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S03 E10 — Hawaiian Plate Lunch
Andrew Zimmern reimagines the Hawaiian plate lunch with a hand chopped venison burger topped with homemade gravy and a fried egg, jumbo grilled shrimp, a humble macaroni salad and a heaping scoop of white rice.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E01 — The Essence of Grill Culture
Chef Andrew Zimmern makes two different dishes with red snapper: fried snapper fingers with a spicy chile-orange mayonnaise dipping sauce and a slow-roasted whole fish with a herb salad and charred miso sweet potatoes.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E02 — Back to Our Caveman Roots
Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S04 E03 — Tailgate Tacos and Bison Bolognese
Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E10 — Wild Boar Feast: Chorizo with Mussels and Whole Roasted Leg
Wild boar takes center stage! Andrew makes chorizo with mussels, preserved lemon & white wine. Then, he slow-roasts a whole leg over fire, served Southern-style with pickled cherries, glazed onions & mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S07 E05 — Venison Satay & Classic Venison Wellington
Andrew cooks an all-venison feast, starting with charred Indonesian satay and a deeply savory peanut sauce, then tackles a classic Wellington with mushroom duxelles, prosciutto, puff pastry and Bordelaise.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E02 — Grilled Yellowtail Collars & Filets with Miso Sauce
Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E03 — The Most Underrated Game Bird
Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E04 — How to Cook a Whole Pig at Home
Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E05 — Bison Brats & Grilled Kebabs on Flatbread
Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E06 — Game Day Fried Squab
Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E07 — The Wild Boar Playbook
Andrew turns wild boar into the ultimate game-day spread with boar and black bean chili topped with crisp cornbread waffles, and pulled boar sliders braised low and slow in Carolina Gold mustard sauce.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E08 — Tailgate Surf-and-Turf Po'Boy Sandwiches
Seafood takes center stage as Andrew fries shrimp, squid and small whole fish for Sicilian-style fritto misto, then layers crispy walleye and oysters into a fully dressed po'boy with savory beef gravy.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E09 — Game Day Chicago-Style Beef Sandwich
Andrew builds a massive Chicago-style fried beef sandwich with peppers, onions and molten cheese before tackling true snout-to-tail cooking: a whole simmered cow head transformed into crispy tacos de cabeza with two salsas.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S06 E10 — The Ultimate Elk Tailgate
It's an elk tailgate over live fire. Andrew makes chorizo-spiced elk meatballs with queso fundido and red chile salsa, then cooks hay-smoked elk chops with charred alliums and black garlic-juniper butter.

title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
description:
S05 E02 — Poultry Perfection: Moroccan Spiced Guinea Hen with Charred Vegetables
Andrew unlocks the rich flavor of guinea hen with a vibrant grilled salad featuring watercress and a mustard-hazelnut vinaigrette. Then, he slow-roasts a whole bird with Middle Eastern spices, served with harissa squash and eggplant-tahini purée.
